name: DevDesignDazzle – Post Views
author: DevDesignDazzle

sections.description:
DevDesignDazzle – Post Views is a lightweight yet powerful solution for tracking and displaying post views on your WordPress site.

Key Features

  • Daily, monthly, and total view tracking
  • Advanced bot detection and filtering
  • Admin view exclusion
  • Session and cookie-based duplicate view prevention
  • Shortcodes for flexible display options
  • Customizable excerpt length in grid displays
  • Comprehensive statistics dashboard
  • Cache-optimized for performance
  • Secure data handling

For more information about “DevDesignDazzle-Post Views”, visit DevDesignDazzle.com.

Usage

  • Use shortcodes to display views
  • Access detailed statistics in the admin panel
  • Customize view display with CSS
  • Integration options for theme developers

Perfect For

  • Blog owners tracking post popularity
  • News sites monitoring article performance
  • Content creators analyzing reader engagement
  • Developers needing view statistics

Privacy Policy

This plugin:
* Stores view counts in your database
* Uses cookies for duplicate view prevention
* Does not collect personal data
* Does not share data with external services
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Access ‘Post Views’ in your admin menu for statistics
  4. Use shortcodes or PHP functions to display views
sections.faq:
How are views counted?

Views are tracked with duplicate prevention using both sessions and cookies (6-hour window). Admin views and bot traffic are automatically filtered out.

How can I display views?

Multiple options available:

  1. Shortcode in post content:
    [dddPostViews] or [dddPostViews timeframe="monthly"]

  2. PHP function in theme files:

  3. Top posts list with customizable excerpt:
    [dddPostViews_top_posts number=”5″ timeframe=”monthly” excerpt_length=”15″]

Does it affect site performance?

No, the plugin uses WordPress caching system and optimized database queries to maintain fast performance.

How are bots filtered?

Advanced bot detection includes:
* Common bot signature filtering
* Automated traffic detection
* Header validation
* Behavior analysis

Cookie Usage

  • Duplicate view prevention cookie expires after 6 hours
  • Cookies are secure and HTTP-only
  • No personal data is stored in cookies

Performance

  • View counts are cached for 1 hour
  • Monthly aggregation runs automatically
  • Database queries are optimized

Developer Constants

  • dddPostViews_POST_VIEWS_VERSION
  • dddPostViews_PLUGIN_PATH
  • dddPostViews_PLUGIN_URL

Can I customize the display?

Yes, use CSS to style:
* .ddd-post-views – Basic view counter
* .ddd-top-posts-grid – Top posts grid container
* .ddd-top-post – Individual post card
* .ddd-post-excerpt – Post excerpt in grid view
* .ddd-post-thumbnail – Post thumbnail container
* .ddd-post-content – Post content wrapper

Display Options

  • Grid layout automatically adjusts to:
    • 1 column on mobile
    • 2 columns on tablet (768px+)
    • 3 columns on desktop (1024px+)

You can also customize:
* Excerpt length using the excerpt_length parameter
* Grid layout appearance using CSS
* Display style (full/minimal) using the display parameter
